SS71.name: 星蚀鰕虎
SS71.form: a small slender cylindrical body, a blunt rounded head, a large mouth, a pair of large eyes set high
SS71.fins: a dorsal fin split into two parts, a rounded tail fin, the pelvic fins fused into a disc
SS71.markings: a faint eclipse ring on the gill cover, a sparse line of luminous pores along the flank

SS72.name: 陨铁巨鲛
SS72.form: a stout torpedo-shaped body with angular faceted armor plates, a long pointed snout, a row of serrated teeth, five gill slits
SS72.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long angular pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin
SS72.markings: a sparse line of luminous pores along the flank, faint crater pits scattered on the back

SS73.name: 星核皇带
SS73.form: a very long slender ribbon-like body, a small blunt head, a single tapering dorsal crest running the whole back, a pair of long trailing pelvic filaments
SS73.fins: a continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced rays, a tiny fan-shaped tail fin
SS73.markings: a line of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the crest, a faint halo behind the head

SS74.name: 幽蓝巨魟
SS74.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with faintly faceted wing panels, a short blunt snout, a long thin whip-like tail with a serrated spine
SS74.fins: wide angular pectoral wings, a low fin fold along the tail
SS74.markings: a sparse arc of luminous pores along each wing edge, a faint ring centred on the disc

SS75.name: 星陨终焉·万象鲸
SS75.form: a colossal rounded body with faintly faceted surface panels, a broad blunt head, a row of ventral throat grooves
SS75.fins: a small set-back dorsal fin, wide horizontal tail flukes
SS75.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points across the back, a faint ringed pattern around each eye

SS76.name: 星陨之主·天鳞
SS76.form: a sinuous serpentine body covered in faintly faceted overlapping scale plates, a tapered head, a pair of large rearward-swept horns, a row of luminous nodes along the spine
SS76.fins: a low continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced spines, a pair of long trailing whisker tendrils
SS76.markings: a single row of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the spine, a faint halo ring behind the head

SS77.name: 渊底月神·银鳐
SS77.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with crisp bevelled wing panels, a short blunt snout, a long thin trailing tail
SS77.fins: wide angular pectoral wings with gently scalloped edges, a low fin fold along the tail
SS77.markings: a faint crescent moon arc across the disc, a sparse arc of luminous pores along each wing edge

SS78.name: 星陨王座·裂空皇带
SS78.form: a very long slender ribbon-like body, a small blunt head crowned by a low faceted crest, a tall dorsal crest running the full length of the back, a pair of long trailing pelvic filaments
SS78.fins: a continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced rays, a tiny fan-shaped tail fin
SS78.markings: a line of luminous nodes along the crest, a single streak splitting the dorsal crest

SS79.name: 深渊终章·噬星者
SS79.form: a sinuous serpentine body with faintly faceted plates, a broad head, a wide gaping mouth set with rows of recurved teeth, a pair of swept-back horns
SS79.fins: a low continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced spines, a pair of long trailing tendrils
SS79.markings: a row of luminous nodes along the spine, a faint ring behind the head

SS80.name: 永夜之主·虚空鲸
SS80.form: a colossal rounded body with faintly faceted surface panels, a broad blunt head, a row of ventral throat grooves, thin ridged jaw edges
SS80.fins: a small set-back dorsal fin, wide horizontal tail flukes
SS80.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points along the flank, a faint void ring on the brow
